# Libraries, paths, data
Here we will just analyse Legrand's 2022 data to check for differences in results that I and Micah/his team got.

```{r}
# Paths
rm(list=ls())
paths=list(base.path='/Users/jacquelinescholl/Documents/Experiments/Tim_Palmer/Cardio_forPublication')
paths$out=file.path(paths$base.path,'Results','ForMicah')
# Libraries
library(tidyverse)
library("rstan") # observe startup messages
options(mc.cores = parallel::detectCores())
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)
library(brms) # regression models
library(lme4) # to compare Micah's results
library(glmmTMB)# the pacakge Micah used

# Load session 1 Legrand and save as single text file for comparison for Micah
folders=list.files(file.path(paths$base.path,'Data','CardioceptionPaper-main','data','raw','HRD'),full.names = T)
cardio.legrand.unfiltered= data.frame()
for (ifold in folders){
  ID=stringr::str_split(ifold,'/')[[1]][length(stringr::str_split(ifold,'/')[[1]])]
  cardio.legrand.unfiltered=rbind(cardio.legrand.unfiltered,
                                  read.csv(file.path(ifold,'filtered.txt')) %>% dplyr::mutate(ID=ID))
}
cardio.legrand =cardio.legrand.unfiltered %>% dplyr::filter(HeartRateOutlier=='False') %>% dplyr::filter(Decision!="")
write.csv(cardio.legrand,
          file=file.path(paths$out,'Cardio_Legrand2022_Session1_FilteredForMicah.csv'),
          row.names = F)

```

#Preprocess the data
Size:
Unique IDs: 218
Total rows: 31882
Rows in intero condition: 14485
```{r}
cardio.legrand=read.csv(file.path(paths$out,'Cardio_Legrand2022_Session1_FilteredForMicah.csv'))
length(unique(cardio.legrand$ID)) # 218
nrow(cardio.legrand) #31882
nrow(cardio.legrand %>% dplyr::filter(Modality=='Intero')) #14485

cardio.legrand.intero.scaledWithinSubj = cardio.legrand %>% dplyr::filter(Modality=="Intero") %>%
  dplyr::group_by(ID) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(listenBPM,responseBPM),~scale(.) %>% as.vector()) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Response.numeric = case_when(
    Decision=="More" ~ 1,
    Decision=="Less" ~ 0
  )) 
cardio.legrand.intero.scaledBetweenSubj = cardio.legrand %>% dplyr::filter(Modality=="Intero") %>%
  dplyr::mutate_at(vars(listenBPM,responseBPM),~scale(.) %>% as.vector()) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(Response.numeric = case_when(
    Decision=="More" ~ 1,
    Decision=="Less" ~ 0
  )) 
```


#Hierarchical regression analyses 
## Response.numeric ~ listenBPM+responseBPM + (listen+responseBPM|ID)
```{r}
fit.brms.modelLinear = brm(Response.numeric~ listenBPM + responseBPM + (listenBPM + responseBPM | ID),
                            data=cardio.legrand.intero.scaledWithinSubj,
                            family=bernoulli(link='logit'),
                            prior=c(prior(normal(0,3),class='b')),
                            iter=10000,warmup=5000,
                            chains=4,cores=4)
fit.lme.modelLinear= lme4=glmer(Response.numeric~ listenBPM + responseBPM + (listenBPM + responseBPM | ID),
                     data=cardio.legrand.intero.scaledWithinSubj,family = binomial,control=glmerControl(optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e4)))
fit.glmmTMB.modelLindear=glmmTMB(
  Response.numeric~ listenBPM + responseBPM + (listenBPM + responseBPM | ID),
  data = cardio.legrand.intero.scaledWithinSubj,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmmTMBControl(parallel = 4) 
)

```
## Response.numeric ~ listenBPM*responseBPM + (listen*responseBPM|ID)
```{r}
fit.brms.modelInteract= brm(Response.numeric~ listenBPM * responseBPM + (listenBPM * responseBPM | ID),
                            data=cardio.legrand.intero.scaledWithinSubj,
                            family=bernoulli(link='logit'),
                            prior=c(prior(normal(0,3),class='b')),
                            iter=10000,warmup=5000,
                            chains=4,cores=4)
fit.lme.modelInteract= lme4=glmer(Response.numeric ~ (listenBPM*responseBPM) + ((listenBPM * responseBPM)|ID),
                     data=cardio.legrand.intero.scaledWithinSubj,family = binomial,control=glmerControl(optCtrl=list(maxfun=2e4)))
fit.glmmTMB.modelInteract=glmmTMB(
  Response.numeric ~ (listenBPM*responseBPM) + ((listenBPM *responseBPM)|ID),
  data = cardio.legrand.intero.scaledWithinSubj,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmmTMBControl(parallel = 4) 
)
```

# Wrong analysis: not individual subject effects for interactions
```{r}

fit.glmmTMB.modelInteract.wrong=glmmTMB(
  Response.numeric ~ (listenBPM*responseBPM) + (listenBPM +responseBPM|ID),
  data = cardio.legrand.intero.scaledWithinSubj,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmmTMBControl(parallel = 4) 
)

fit.glmmTMB.modelInteract.wrong.BetweenSubjZscore=glmmTMB(
  Response.numeric ~ (listenBPM*responseBPM) + (listenBPM +responseBPM|ID),
  data = cardio.legrand.intero.scaledBetweenSubj,
  family = binomial(link = "logit"),
  control = glmmTMBControl(parallel = 4) 
)


```
